symbols.name: ICacheStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Owns one complete authoritative cache store, including payload, indexes, fences, quota, readers, and recovery.
symbols.remarks: No operation may substitute an unbounded payload scan for an indexed metadata query. Cancellation does not prove native I/O stopped.

syntax.content: public interface ICacheStoreProvider

symbols.name: InitializeAsync(IReadOnlyList, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Checks readiness, format/catalog compatibility, and required deployed schema without applying DDL.

syntax.content: ValueTask InitializeAsync(IReadOnlyList collections, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: LookupAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CacheReadRequest, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Acquires one indexed validity/fence/optional payload snapshot. Negative entries need no stream.

syntax.content: ValueTask> LookupAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CacheReadRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ValidateReadAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CacheEntryVersion, CacheReadRequest, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Establishes authoritative validity on every hot reuse without reading payload content unless explicitly requested.

syntax.content: ValueTask> ValidateReadAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CacheEntryVersion expectedVersion, CacheReadRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: CaptureFenceAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Captures publication authority before engine-managed source access or direct staging.

syntax.content: ValueTask> CaptureFenceAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ReleaseFenceAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CachePublicationFence, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Releases bounded captured source/staging authority after the actual work ends. Repeated release is harmless.

syntax.content: ValueTask ReleaseFenceAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CachePublicationFence fence, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: BeginWriteAsync(CacheProviderWriteRequest, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Starts bounded same-store staging without changing the current visible version.

syntax.content: ValueTask> BeginWriteAsync(CacheProviderWriteRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: TouchAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CacheEntryVersion?, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Atomically renews authoritative sliding expiry, bounded by its persisted absolute cap.

syntax.content: ValueTask> TouchAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CacheEntryVersion? expectedVersion = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: RemoveAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CacheWriteCondition, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Fences the key even when absent, then conditionally removes its current version. A conflict changes nothing.

syntax.content: ValueTask> RemoveAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CacheWriteCondition condition = default, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: RemoveAsync(CacheProviderRemoval, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Atomically verifies captured source authority and removes an expected version without retaining an absence marker.

syntax.content: ValueTask> RemoveAsync(CacheProviderRemoval request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: QueryAsync(CacheMetadataQuery, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Returns a bounded payload-free indexed page across retained contract versions.

syntax.content: ValueTask> QueryAsync(CacheMetadataQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: QueryRefreshAsync(CacheRefreshQuery, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Queries bounded indexed refresh metadata for the host's current contract without payload access or foreground activity.

syntax.content: ValueTask> QueryRefreshAsync(CacheRefreshQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: RecordRefreshAttemptAsync(CacheRefreshAttempt, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Conditionally records finite scheduler backoff against the same current version; obsolete attempts are harmless.

syntax.content: ValueTask RecordRefreshAttemptAsync(CacheRefreshAttempt attempt, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: InvalidateAsync(CacheProviderInvalidation, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Establishes invalidation fences before bounded version-conditional deletion. Empty selection matches nothing.

syntax.content: ValueTask> InvalidateAsync(CacheProviderInvalidation request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: AcquireOwnershipAsync(CacheOwnershipRequest, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Attempts authoritative shared-store ownership. Unavailable or uncertain authority fails closed.

syntax.content: ValueTask> AcquireOwnershipAsync(CacheOwnershipRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: RenewOwnershipAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CacheOwnerToken, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Renews confirmed ownership only within the fixed deadline and while interested callers remain.

syntax.content: ValueTask> RenewOwnershipAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CacheOwnerToken owner, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ObserveOwnershipAsync(CacheOwnershipRequest, string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Registers/renews bounded remote interest and observes one flight. It never invokes source work.

syntax.content: ValueTask> ObserveOwnershipAsync(CacheOwnershipRequest request, string flightId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: CompleteOwnershipAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, CacheOwnerToken, CacheOwnershipCompletion, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Completes a confirmed owned flight atomically; no uncached typed value crosses nodes.

syntax.content: ValueTask CompleteOwnershipAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, CacheOwnerToken owner, CacheOwnershipCompletion completion, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ReleaseInterestAsync(CacheEntryIdentity, string, string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Withdraws one local observation group's interest without cancelling other interested callers.

syntax.content: ValueTask ReleaseInterestAsync(CacheEntryIdentity identity, string flightId, string interestId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: MaintainAsync(CacheMaintenanceRequest, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Performs bounded native cleanup/recovery and retains unresolved charges.

syntax.content: ValueTask> MaintainAsync(CacheMaintenanceRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: GetQuotaAsync(CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Returns storage/quota accounting without traversing payloads.

syntax.content: ValueTask> GetQuotaAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ReconcileAsync(string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Reconciles an uncertain write using its stable provider operation identity.

syntax.content: ValueTask> ReconcileAsync(string operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: SaveOperationAsync(CacheProviderOperation, string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Creates or conditionally transitions bounded provider-owned operation state.

syntax.content: ValueTask> SaveOperationAsync(CacheProviderOperation operation, string expectedRevision = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: GetOperationAsync(string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Reads provider-owned operation state; missing state is an explicit NotFound failure.

syntax.content: ValueTask> GetOperationAsync(string operationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: GetOperationsAsync(int, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Returns a bounded page of tracked operation records.

syntax.content: ValueTask>> GetOperationsAsync(int limit = 100, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: Name
symbols.summary: Gets the registered stable provider name.

syntax.content: string Name { get; }

symbols.name: Capabilities
symbols.summary: Gets truthful native store capabilities.

syntax.content: CacheProviderCapabilities Capabilities { get; }
